Method of Attack: Targets Nextcloud instances by finding the victim's NextCloud file share and sync data directory via config.php, deletes folders that could be used to restore files, then encrypts all files in the data directory using AES-256 encryption with file names and contents Base64 encoded
Ransomware encrypts files and appends extension 'NextCry', demands ransom in BTC
Impacted Systems: NextCloud file sync and share service
Nextcloud instances running on Linux servers with NGINX
Attack Vector: Exploitation of PHP-FPM (FastCGI Process Manager) remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2019-11043 in default Nextcloud NGINX configuration
Access gained via SSH lockout after exploiting vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Malware compiled Python script in Linux ELF binary using pyInstaller
Base64 encoded file names and contents
Bitcoin wallet address provided in ransom note
